children.name: Orthalicus
children.description: Orthalicus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Orthalicus bensoni
children.description: Shell sculptured with dense spiral lines, colour pattern predominantly with three small spiral bands of dark reddish-brown interrupted with white << marks, aperture with a small dark band behind the lip, around the columellar margin, and on the parietal wall.

children.name: Orthalicus bifulguratus
children.description: Shell sculptured with a dense pattern of fine spiral lines, coloured with pairs of yellow, irregularly waving and zigzag, longitudinal bands bordered with dark brown on the right side.

children.name: Orthalicus maracaibensis L.Pfeiffer, 1856
children.description: Orthalicus maracaibensis is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Orthalicus mars L.Pfeiffer, 1861
children.description: Shell ovate-conical, upper whorls with a colour pattern of longitudinal, dark brown streaks, broad on the lower half, forked on the upper half of whorl, separated by whitish ' 3 - like' shapes, pattern fading on the last whorls, aperture dark brown bordered inside, columellar margin and parietal callus also dark brown.

children.name: Orthalicus phlogerus
children.description: Shell elongate-conical, upper whorls with a colour pattern of longitudinal, dark brown streaks, broad on the lower half, forked on the upper half of whorl, separated by whitish ' 3 - like' shapes, pattern fading on the last whorl, aperture whitish.

children.name: Orthalicus reses
children.description: Orthalicus reses, the Stock Island tree snail or the Florida tree snail, is a species of large tropical air-breathing tree snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Orthalicus undatus
children.description: Orthalicus undatus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Liguus
children.description: Liguus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Liguus fasciatus
children.description: Liguus fasciatus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a tree snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Liguus virgineus
children.description: Liguus virgineus, also known as the candy cane snail, is a species of tree-living snail native to the Caribbean island of Hispaniola.

children.name: Liguus vittatus
children.description: Liguus vittatus, commonly known as the ribbon liguus, is a species of land snail in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Leuchocharis
children.description: Leuchocharis — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Corona
children.description: Corona — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Corona incisa
children.description: Shell sinistral or dextral, conic-ovate, solid, changing in ground colour from creamy (top) to tawny (last whorl) with a narrow girdle at the periphery of yellowish, arrow-like markings (>>) and darker sections in between, numerous narrow axial streaks, overlying few broader ones in the basic pattern.

children.name: Corona perversa
children.description: Corona perversa is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Corona regalis
children.description: Shell sinistral or dextral, solid, ground colour brownish to whitish, the upper whorls gradually turning into pinkish, a dark peripheral band may be present, columellar margin bordered by a dark band, extending in the dark parietal callus.

children.name: Sultana
children.description: Sultana — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Sultana atramentaria
children.description: Shell light coloured with brownish sinuous streaks, which merge on the last whorl, aperture with a dark brown band inside behind the lip, columellar magin and parietal callus also dark brown.

children.name: Sultana deburghiae
children.description: Shell with broad dark stripes separated by light coloured, narrow zigzag stripes, a wide umbilical zone paler, two narrow dark bands at the periphery and around the umbilical area, both interrupted by light spots.

children.name: Sultana fraseri
children.description: Shell with yellowish ground colour and very narrow, interrupted, longitudinal dark brown stripes, especially on last whorl, and up to five spiral bands crossed by sinuous markings, peristome white, parietal callus and upper part of columellar margin lilac-whitish.

children.name: Sultana kellettii
children.description: Shell tawny coloured, the upper whorls paler, last whorl with three spiral bands of dark brown, interrupted by sinuous streaks, aperture whitish inside with a darker band behind lip, parietal callus dark.

children.name: Sultana labeo
children.description: Shell light to dark brown, with three (indistinct) spiral bands on the last whorl, interrupted by a few, oblique, light-coloured streaks, apex blunt, aperture with a calloused peristome, flesh- to dark-brown coloured on the front side, dirty whitish on the dorsal side.

children.name: Sultana macandrewi
children.description: Shell coloured with a grayish-fulvous zone below the suture, and two light brown zones at the periphery and on the lower part of last whorl, aperture lilac within, peristome black-edged (after Sowerby III 1889).

children.name: Sultana sultana
children.description: Sultana sultana is a species of snail from the genus Sultana.

children.name: Porphyrobaphe
children.description: Porphyrobaphe — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Porphyrobaphe iostoma
children.description: Porphyrobaphe iostoma is a species of land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Orthalicidae.

children.name: Porphyrobaphe subirroratus
children.description: Shell yellowish-brown with a close pattern of longitudinal stripes, partly forked, upper whorls uniformly brown, spiral sculpture dense on last whorl, peristome whitish, parietal callus dark-whitish.

children.name: Hemibulimus
children.description: Hemibulimus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Scholvienia
children.description: Scholvienia — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Scholvienia bambamarcaensis
children.description: Shell with rather convex sides, height / diameter ratio 2.2, russet-brown with a yellowish subsutural band, sculptured with fine spiral striation, height of aperture more than 0.4 times shell height.

children.name: Scholvienia gittenbergerorum
children.description: Shell tawny coloured, on the last whorl indistinct, darker coloured spiral bands are present, teleoconch sculptured with incrassate growth striae, thickened at irregular distances forming peculiar whitish longitudinal stripes, partly fading away at lower side of whorl, and crossed by shallow spiral lines.

children.name: Scholvienia jaspidea
children.description: Shell with hardly convex sides, tawny coloured with some darker patches, sculptured with incrassate growth striae, especially on the last whorl thickened at irregular distances, crossed by spiral lines resulting in oblong granulation, aperture with columellar margin well dilated above.

children.name: Scholvienia jelskii
children.description: Shell with straight sides, reddish-brown coloured with three spiral band, two small (subsutural, peripheral) and one broader (around the umbilical area on the lower part of last whorl).

children.name: Scholvienia porphyria
children.description: Shell brownish coloured, on the last whorl a small, lighter coloured peripheral band is present, teleoconch sculptured with incrassate growth striae, thickened at irregular distances forming peculiar whitish longitudinal stripes, partly fading away at lower side of whorl, and crossed by shallow spiral lines.

children.name: Scholvienia weyrauchi
children.description: Shell with straight sides, reddish-brown coloured with three narrow spiral band, one subsutural and two slightly broader (above and below the periphery of last whorl).

children.name: Kara
children.description: Kara — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Kara cadwaladeri
children.description: Shell elongate, uniformly dark brown coloured on the last whorl, upper whorls somewhat paler, a small white girdle below the crenulate suture, aperture relatively small, columellar margin relatively dilated above.

children.name: Kara ortiziana
children.description: Shell elongate-ovate, coloured with olive buff with darker brown, axial striae, suture crenulate, height of aperture 0.57 times total shell height, ovate, pointed above, widely rounded below, peristome simple, parietal wall covered by a transparent callus (modified after Haas 1955).

children.name: Kara thompsonii
children.description: Shell (rather) elongate, coloured with yellowish to brown, with light to darker brown, axial streaks, the upper whorls paler, a white girdle below the crenulate suture, aperture height less than half the shell height, peristome simple, whitish, a darker band inside the aperture behind the lip.

children.name: Kara viriata
children.description: Shell ovate-conic, colour yellowish [with brownish axial streaks], upper whorls pale, aperture height slightly over half the shell height, peristome simple, whitish, parietal callus thin and translucent-whitish.

children.name: Kara yanamensis
children.description: Shell ovate-conic, colour yellowish with brownish axial streaks, upper whorls pale, aperture height slightly over half the shell height, peristome simple, whitish, parietal callus thin and translucent-whitish.

children.name: Quechua
children.description: Quechua — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Quechua salteri
children.description: Shell sculptured with irregular longitudinal and spiral striation, giving a malleated appearance, with brown markings and a few longitudinal streaks, aperture pale-purple inside, parietal callus transparent.

children.name: Clathrorthalicus
children.description: Clathrorthalicus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Clathrorthalicus corydon
children.description: Shell (elongate-) ovate, creamy ground colour with a nubelous pattern of streaks and spots of russet-brown, indistinctly sculptured with growth striae, suture hardly ascending behind the lip, aperture with well expanded and reflexed peristome.

children.name: Clathrorthalicus magnificus
children.description: Shell very thin, ground colour creamy-pink with somewhat undulating, axial streaks of brown and on the last whorl two spiral bands with arrow-like (<<) blotches, aperture elongate-ovate, with truncate-sprouted base, very thin and simple peristome.

children.name: Clathrorthalicus phoebus
children.description: Shell ovate, creamy ground colour with few axial streaks and spots of russet-brown, on the last whorls a lighter subsutural band is visible, indistinctly sculptured with growth striae, suture hardly ascending behind the lip, aperture with well expanded and reflexed peristome.

children.name: Paeniscutalus
children.description: Paeniscutalus — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Cortana
children.description: Cortana — a genus of gastropodas.

children.name: Cortana carvalhoi
children.description: Cortana is a fossil genus of medium-sized air-breathing land snails, terrestrial pulmonate gastropods in the family Amphibulimidae.

children.name: Aposcutalus
children.description: Aposcutalus — a genus of gastropodas.
